name: Build Linux System Libs

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/build_linux_systemlibs.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        variant: [basic, hardsubx]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            build-essential \
            cmake \
            pkg-config \
            libavcodec-dev \
            libavformat-dev \
            libavutil-dev \
            libavfilter-dev \
            libswscale-dev \
            libswresample-dev \
            libtesseract-dev \
            libleptonica-dev \
            libpng-dev \
            libjpeg-dev \
            libfreetype-dev \
            libfontconfig1-dev \
            libxml2-dev \
            libx11-dev \
            libxext-dev \
            libxrender-dev \
            libxtst-dev \
            libxrandr-dev \
            libxcursor-dev \
            libxi-dev \
            libxcomposite-dev \
            libxdamage-dev \
            libxfixes-dev \
            libxinerama-dev \
            libxss-dev \
            libxv-dev \
            libxvmc-dev \
            libgl1-mesa-dev \
            libglu1-mesa-dev \
            libglib2.0-dev \
            libgtk-3-dev \
            qtbase5-dev \
            qtbase5-dev-tools \
            qttools5-dev \
            qttools5-dev-tools \
            libqt5multimedia5 \
            libqt5multimedia5-plugins \
            libqt5multimediawidgets5 \
            libqt5multimedia5-dev \
            libqt5multimediawidgets5-dev

      - name: Configure CMake
        run: |
          mkdir -p build
          cd build
          if [ "${{ matrix.variant }}" == "hardsubx" ]; then
            cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DUSE_SYSTEM_LIBS=ON -DENABLE_HARDSUBX=ON
          else
            cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DUSE_SYSTEM_LIBS=ON
          fi

      - name: Build
        run: |
          cd build
          make -j$(nproc)

      - name: Verify system library linking
        run: |
          cd build
          ldd ccextractor | grep -E "libav|libsw|libtesseract|libqt" || true

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ccextractor-linux-systemlibs-${{ matrix.variant }}
          path: build/ccextractor
